raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Batch 12 arrived with lowercase status ('posted'/'reversed') and '$'-prefixed amounts. The strict filter status = 'POSTED' drops all of its posted rows (334), and the '$' prefix would break the DECIMAL cast once those rows were included. Fix: normalize status case and strip '$' (and any thousands commas) from amount in silver_transactions; the gold tables rebuild from it.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.92,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(replace(replace(trim(CAST(amount AS VARCHAR)), '$', ''), ',', '') AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE upper(trim(status)) = 'POSTED'"}}
